beats.title: Warnings at Bhishma’s Temple
beats.boundaryReason: The opening recap leads into the temple approach, depleted resources, and detection of undead; Kenzo’s reconnaissance proposal starts the next beat.
dateEvidence: Session drStart anchors May 11; u0021–u0030 explicitly place the current action shortly before sunset.

beats.title: Testing the Temple Shadows
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo investigates under invisibility, tests the shadows against light, and returns to the party before they leave the building.
dateEvidence: Same continuous temple visit; u0335 places sunset 15–20 minutes away and u0706–u0708 describe the last sunlight leaving the windows.

beats.title: Retreat and Night Watches
beats.boundaryReason: The party exits the temple, returns to camp, and rests; the following beat begins at dawn, a clear day boundary.
dateEvidence: u0711–u0784 cover departure at sunset and evening camp; u0813–u0842 establish overnight watches, with Seeker and Wellby taking the middle-night and pre-dawn watches at u0858–u0885.

beats.title: Why Scout Kharsan?
beats.boundaryReason: At dawn the party reconsiders reconnaissance and interprets the fort’s architecture; Wellby’s active search starts the next beat.
dateEvidence: u0889 explicitly begins dawn after the overnight rest; May 12 follows the May 11 evening.

beats.title: Missing Bodies and Searching Orcs
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby’s investigation reveals vanished corpses, a freed captive, and approaching patrols, changing the discussion into an urgent escape problem.
dateEvidence: u1164 explicitly places Wellby’s search in early morning; u1201 and u1228 describe approaching patrols during the same morning.

beats.title: Choosing the Southern Detour
beats.boundaryReason: The party weighs ambush and deception before committing to ride south and circle back west; actual travel begins at u1581.
dateEvidence: Continuous discussion after Wellby’s early-morning report; u1556–u1559 give minutes until the patrols reach the monastery and camp.

beats.title: Hard Riding and Exhaustion
beats.boundaryReason: A compact travel montage covers the southern detour, forced march, and night watches; retained as a short beat because departure and the next pre-dawn awakening are strong situation and day boundaries.
dateEvidence: u1593 specifies about 3 p.m.; u1601 reaches sunset; u1621 adds about an hour of travel; u1648–u1650 explicitly carry the watches to about 3 a.m. on the following day.

beats.title: A Hawk over Kharsan
beats.boundaryReason: The party rises before dawn, reaches the road, scouts the city by hawk, and conceals the mounts; the approach on foot begins next.
dateEvidence: u1653–u1655 explicitly wake the party just before 5 a.m. after the second overnight rest; u1684 gives 9–9:30 a.m. and u1706 gives 9:30–10 a.m.

beats.title: Reaching the Bridge Unseen
beats.boundaryReason: The party plans the sensor placement, reaches the bridge under stealth and invisibility, and prepares simultaneous reconnaissance in the palace and northern ruins.
dateEvidence: Same morning as the hawk scouting; u1909 explicitly says the sun is still in the east before noon.

beats.title: Seeker Watches Grash
beats.boundaryReason: Two successive Clairvoyance castings reveal Grash’s killings, necromancy, orders, and Sending; the narration then switches to Delwath’s concurrent scouting.
dateEvidence: Continuous bridge reconnaissance after u1909; u2140–u2141 give the first spell’s ten-minute duration and u2212 starts the second casting.

beats.title: Voices in the Northern Ruins
beats.boundaryReason: The narration returns to Delwath’s simultaneous expedition, follows his discoveries and return, and ends with the party regrouped at the bridge.
dateEvidence: u2328 explicitly says Delwath’s scouting occurs while Seeker’s observations are going on; u2454 estimates twenty minutes in the city, and u2494 defers leaving Kharsan until next session.
